# QME AI Hero

> Open, MIT-licensed Claude Code skills for California QME (Qualified Medical Evaluator) work, from Tresa. Every skill runs in the physician's own account; no case material is sent to us.

## Pages

- [Start Here](https://qmeaihero.com/): what the project is and why you should not have to trust AI blindly
- [Skills](https://qmeaihero.com/skills.html): the skill lifecycle and how to install
- [Environment audit](https://qmeaihero.com/qme-env-audit.html): trace PHI through the systems you already use
- [Draft review](https://qmeaihero.com/draft-review.html): review tooling

## Machine-readable

- [skills.md](https://qmeaihero.com/skills.md): one entry per skill with install path
- [sitemap.md](https://qmeaihero.com/sitemap.md)
- [rss.xml](https://qmeaihero.com/rss.xml)

- https://github.com/jkgoldst/qme-skills
